title: 第25章 封王试炼第26章 同代称王
content_zh:
疑惑间，神殿内传来一声石门开启的声响。
秦玄看过去，只见到不远处同样有一扇古老的石门开启，一道风华绝代的倩影迈步走出，踏入神殿内。
少女看上去双八年华出头，青丝如瀑，姿色倾人世，穿戴一件火红色的女式贴身铠甲，呈现出完美绝伦的魅惑曲线。
双腿修长，唯有螓首裸露在外，显得格外冷艳，却又予人一种巾帼不让须眉之感。
秦玄也为之惊艳，如此姿色，堪称是倾绝人世间。
柳芸与之相比起来，不过是荧荧之火与日月争辉罢了。
同样察觉到秦玄的存在，少女一剪秋水的明眸看了过来，并无想象中的倨傲，而是微微颔首，主动报上名号：“荒京，纳兰倾城。”
荒京？
秦玄心里疑惑，并没听闻这个地名，或许是大赵王朝外的其他地名。
因为斗塔的分部，不仅仅只是在大赵王朝，在天下无数王朝，乃至更上级的皇朝，都有所分部。
“天峰城，秦玄。”
秦玄同样也报上名号。
纳兰倾城同样露出疑惑之色，似乎在寻思着，天峰城到底在哪里。
可细细思索片刻后，依旧没有得出任何答案。
这便奇怪了，既然有人能够来到此地，天峰城绝非寻常之地才是。
初次见面，纳兰倾城也不好追问，朝秦玄略微颔首示意后，便看向远方尽头的巍峨神像，俏颜上露出一抹凝重之色，主动地走上前，来到了两排铠甲石像中央。
秦玄看着她的举动，他有种感觉，这个纳兰倾城似乎知道关于这座神殿的一些秘密，眼下的举动绝非毫无意义的。
果不其然，就在这时，一道淡漠无情的声音响彻神殿内：“你，是否愿意挑战封王之试？”
纳兰倾城扬起螓首，坚定道：“我愿意！”
“封王之试，开始！”

“坚持一刻时间，当可封王！”
伴随着声音落下，神殿两侧各自走出了三尊高大的石像，并且迅速缩小，化作了正常人大小。
共计六尊石像，或是手持利剑，或是手持大刀，或是手持石锤，或是手持长枪等等，各自抓住不同的兵器，瞬间就冲向纳兰倾城。
速度极快，眨眼间就冲到了纳兰倾城面前，六人彻底包围住了她所有方向，同时攻击，蕴含着极致可怖的力量。
纳兰倾城显然乃是天纵横溢之辈，虽为女子，但却远强于同辈男子，瞬息间便是在身遭浮现出一头头古象虚影，咆哮着冲向四方。
“天罡境！”
秦玄露出惊色，唯有天罡境才能修炼出古象之力，一象之力便是等同于十牛之力，也就是十万斤。
而且古象虚影之多，足有八十头之多。
如同真武境一般，古象虚影的多少，便是衡量天罡境层次武修实力的强弱。
毫无疑问，这纳兰倾城天赋超绝，在天罡境修炼出如此之多的古象之力，绝对是逆天级的妖孽。
轰轰轰轰轰轰——
content_en:
In the midst of doubts, there was a sound of the stone door opening in the temple.
Qin Xuan looked over and saw an ancient stone door opening not far away, and a graceful figure stepped out and entered the temple.
The girl looks to be in her early teens, with black hair like a waterfall, and her beauty is world-famous. She is wearing a fiery red women's personal armor, showing perfect and charming curves.
Her legs are long and slender, with only her head exposed, which makes her look particularly cold and glamorous, yet it also gives people the feeling of being a woman but not a man.
Qin Xuan was also amazed by it. Such beauty could be said to be unparalleled in the world.
Compared with it, Liu Yun is nothing more than the glow of Yingying's fire competing with the sun and moon.
Also aware of Qin Xuan's presence, the girl looked over with bright eyes. She was not as arrogant as she imagined. Instead, she nodded slightly and took the initiative to announce her name: "Huangjing, Nalan Qingcheng."
Huang Jing?
Qin Xuan was confused because he had never heard of this place name. It might be the name of another place outside the Zhao Dynasty.
Because the branches of Dou Tower are not only in the Great Zhao Dynasty, but also in countless dynasties in the world, and even higher dynasties.
"Tianfeng City, Qin Xuan."
Qin Xuan also reported his name.
Nalan Qingcheng also looked puzzled, seeming to be wondering where Tianfeng City was.
But after thinking carefully for a while, I still didn't come up with any answer.
This is strange. Since someone can come here, Tianfeng City is definitely an unusual place.
When they met for the first time, Nalan Qingcheng didn't want to ask questions. After nodding slightly to Qin Xuan, he looked at the towering statues at the far end. With a solemn look on his pretty face, he took the initiative to step forward and came to the center of the two rows of armored stone statues.
Qin Xuan looked at her actions, and he had a feeling that Nalan Qingcheng seemed to know some secrets about this temple, and his current actions were by no means meaningless.
Sure enough, at this moment, an indifferent voice resounded through the temple: "Are you willing to challenge the kingship test?"
Nalan Qingcheng raised her head and said firmly: "I do!"
"The trial for kingship begins!"
"If you persist for just a moment, you will be crowned king!"
As the voice fell, three tall stone statues walked out from both sides of the temple, and quickly shrank to the size of a normal person.
There were six stone statues in total, either holding sharp swords, holding broadswords, holding stone hammers, or holding spears, etc. Each of them grabbed a different weapon and rushed towards Nalan Qingcheng in an instant.
The speed was extremely fast, and they rushed in front of Nalan Qingcheng in the blink of an eye. The six people completely surrounded her from all directions and attacked at the same time, which contained extremely terrifying power.
Nalan Qingcheng was obviously a powerful person. Although she was a woman, she was far stronger than the men of her generation. In an instant, shadows of ancient elephants appeared around her, roaring and rushing in all directions.
"Tiangang Realm!"
Qin Xuan looked shocked. Only the Tiangang realm can cultivate the power of ancient elephants. The power of one elephant is equivalent to the power of ten oxen, which is one hundred thousand kilograms.
Moreover, there are so many phantoms of ancient elephants, as many as eighty.
Just like the true martial arts realm, the number of ancient elephant shadows is a measure of the strength of the martial arts at the Tiangang realm.
There is no doubt that Nalan Qingcheng is extremely talented and has cultivated so much ancient elephant power in the Tiangang Realm. He is definitely a heaven-defying monster.
Boom boom boom boom boom——
